preconditions.description: The number of destinations n is between 2 and 10^5, inclusive.
The number of Time Corridors m is between n-1 and 10^6, inclusive.
The destinations a and b are between 1 and n, inclusive.
The destinations a and b are different.
The energy e is between 0 and 10^9, inclusive.
No pair of destinations will repeat in the input.

preconditions.expression: the graph is guaranteed to be connected
preconditions.description: The graph formed by the corridors is connected.

preconditions.expression: all energy requirements e are distinct

postconditions.description: The output contains m-(n-1) lines, one for each corridor not in the minimum spanning tree.

postconditions.expression: each line contains one integer E_{max}(c_i)
postconditions.description: Each line contains the maximum energy E_{max}(c_i) such that changing the energy of corridor c_i to this value would make it part of the Daleks' plan.
